content:
As a Jira administrator, you can use screen schemes to select the screens your team sees when creating, editing, or viewing a work item. Follow the steps on this page to learn how to create a screen scheme, associate screens with work item operations, and activate your changes using a work type screen scheme.
Adding a screen scheme
Depending on your requirements, you may want to create multiple screen schemes, and associate them with different spaces and work types.
- Select Settings () then Work items.
- Under SCREENS, select Screen schemes.
- Select Add screen scheme.
- Add a name, description, and default screen. You'll be able to edit the name and description at any time.
- Select Add.
Deleting a screen scheme
Note that screen schemes that are associated with a work type screen scheme cannot be deleted. You will first need to edit the work type screen scheme and remove the screen scheme.
- Select Settings () then Work items.
- Under SCREENS, select Screen schemes.
- Select Delete next to the relevant screen scheme.
Copying a screen scheme
- Select Settings () then Work items.
- Under SCREENS, select Screen schemes.
- Select Copy next to the relevant screen scheme.
- Enter the name and description of the new screen scheme and select Copy.
Configuring a screen scheme
Associating a screen with a work item operation
Within a screen scheme, you can associate each work item operation (create, view, edit) with a single screen. The default option will be used for any work item operations without an associated screen.
- Select Settings () then Work items.
- Under SCREENS, select Screen schemes.
- Select Configure next to the relevant screen scheme.
- Select Associate a work item operation with a screen.
- Select the work item operation (e.g. create, edit, view) and the desired screen.
- Select Add.
